info.name: EMS - Employee Management System API
info.description:
Production Postman Collection for the EMS RESTful API.

### Key Architecture Principles:
- **Strict 2-Verb Model**: Exclusively uses `GET` and `POST` methods (No PUT/PATCH/DELETE).
- **ADR-001 Envelope Standard**: Every response conforms to `{ is_error, message, data, errors }`.
- **Authentication**: Laravel Sanctum Bearer tokens (`Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`).
- **Role-Based Workflows**: Managers can self-register and manage HR resources; Employees are provisioned by managers and login-only.

item.name: 2. Departments
item.description: Organization department management endpoints. Accessible by all authenticated staff for viewing; mutation requires Manager role.

query.description: Search query for department name or code

request.description: Retrieve paginated list of company departments with total employee count.
Retrieve single department details including linked designations and headcounts.
Create a new organizational department (Manager only).
Update an existing department's name, code, or description (Strict 2-verb POST endpoint).
Safely delete a department. Blocked with 422 if active employees or designations are assigned.

item.name: 3. Designations
item.description: Job titles and designations scoped to departments. Mutation restricted to Managers.

request.description: Retrieve list of job titles and designations with department associations.
Retrieve single designation details.
Create a new designation attached to a department.
Update designation attributes (POST verb).
Remove a designation record. Blocked if active employees are assigned.

item.name: 4. Employees
item.description: Core employee lifecycle and profile management. Employees can view directories; Managers can onboard, modify, change status, and offboard.

query.description: Filter by status: active, probation, on_leave, terminated
Search by first name, last name, employee code, or email

request.description: Browse company employee directory with nested department, designation, and manager details.
Retrieve comprehensive employee profile.
Onboards a new employee into the organization. Creates their user login credentials and employee profile simultaneously. Only Managers can perform this action.
Updates an employee's personal and organizational details (POST verb).
Updates an employee's lifecycle status (`active`, `probation`, `on_leave`, `terminated`).
Offboards and deletes an employee profile and soft-deletes their user credentials.

item.name: 5. Attendance & Punch
item.description: Daily punch-in/out tracking and attendance history. Enforces one punch-in and punch-out per calendar day.

query.description: Filter by employee ID (Managers can filter any, employees see own)

request.description: List attendance history. Non-manager employees are automatically scoped to only their own logs.
Inspect today's live punch state: `is_clocked_in`, `is_clocked_out`, and today's attendance record.
Clock in for today. Fails if user has already clocked in today (422).
Clock out for today and compute total worked hours. Fails if not clocked in or already clocked out (422).

item.name: 6. Daily Work Reports
item.description: End-of-day standup work reports. Employees submit their daily progress; Managers review and provide feedback.

request.description: List daily reports feed. Employees see their own reports; Managers see their team members' reports.
Retrieve complete report details including employee information, associated attendance log, and manager remarks.
Submit today's daily work report. Auto-links to today's attendance record if clocked in. One report allowed per day (422 on duplicate).
Update a pending daily report before it is reviewed by a manager.
Managers review a team member's daily work report and attach official remarks and feedback. Managers cannot review their own reports.

item.name: 7. Leave Management
item.description: Leave policy configuration and leave application approval workflow.

item.name: Leave Types
item.description: Configurable annual leave quotas and policies.

request.description: List all configured leave types (e.g. Annual, Sick, Casual, Maternity).
Retrieve details of a single leave type.
Create a new leave type policy (Manager only).
Update an existing leave type's parameters (POST verb).
Delete a leave type. Fails if leave requests are already attached to it.

item.name: Leave Requests
item.description: State-machine-governed leave application requests (Pending -> Approved / Rejected / Cancelled).

query.description: Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected, cancelled

request.description: List leave applications. Employees see only their own requests; Managers see all requests requiring approval.
Retrieve full details of a leave application.
Submit a new leave application. Automatically verifies the employee has sufficient remaining quota for the year. State initializes to 'pending'.
Managers approve a pending leave application. Fails if manager tries to approve their own request.
Managers reject a pending leave application with a required reason.
Employees cancel their own pending leave request.
